claims.finding: The pre-print options tape in this name was almost purely one-sided calls: 152,490 contracts traded on 2026-08-28 of which 97.94% were calls, with 40k volume in the 9/4 expiry alone and consecutive days on the 'Largest CALL OI Increases' list, while the stock rallied 8.45% in five sessions into a print whose own history is 6 down out of 8.
claims.why_not_priced: The individual flow prints are public but nobody aggregates 'the long side has already been bought' into the pre-print narrative; the wire copy for this name is consensus EPS and the AI-adoption story. If the crowding were reflected in the price the stock would not have gone up 8.45% in the week before a print it has historically fallen on, and the 35%-of-float short base would not still be there for the flow to be trading against. This is a positioning read, not a fundamental one, and the band is deliberately wide and two-sided because a 48.1m-share short base can also squeeze violently on any contract news.
claims.independence: Same source cluster, so it is one finding not three, but the corroborating datapoints are separate messages from different posters and are reinforced by a sell-side note pointing the other way from the flow: DA Davidson reiterated Underperform with a $7 price target on 2026-09-01, https://price-target.com/2026/09/01/173758/ (docs/4954016beba6c404c8c5125434b65f561d9f7689.txt).
